title.zh: 有出处的 WHAMP 存储表

summary: Expose the literal WHAMP reference table as typed package data, retaining the source metadata limits.

identity.relation: Attributed WHAMP stored table to typed reference data
identity.definition: Return the exact 40-row four-column source whpdat and its kxwhp,kzwhp,wrwhp,wiwhp columns.
identity.model: Stored external-solver reference observations; not an executable WHAMP solver.
identity.geometry: The source kx column is the literal constant 0.5.
identity.coordinates: Column units and complete run normalization are not stated in the source.
identity.boundary: No interpolation, fit or physical setup reconstruction.
assumptions: Missing source physical metadata remains unknown.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult state whpdat plus kxwhp,kzwhp,wrwhp,wiwhp literal column arrays.
outputs.constraints: No units, equilibrium or solver version are inferred; receipt is execution metadata.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
excluded: A new WHAMP solve, calibration oracle, or inferred physical units/equilibrium.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: PDRK loss_cone_mirror whamp_dat stored table; data retained with attribution and without inventing missing physical metadata.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

example.description: Read the stored table without assigning unstated units.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.reference import whamp_reference
r = whamp_reference()
assert r.state["whpdat"].shape == (40, 4)
example.expected: The exact attributed 40 by 4 source table.

scope: Literal table identity and typed column mapping.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Source units, complete equilibrium and run metadata are unspecified.
